Our intelligence identifies her as a ''failed'' commander, a ''liability'' to the Republic. In fact, according to this, you ''yourself'' faced her on ''Haruun Kal''…where you ''decimated'' her troops and very nearly ''ended'' her life.|Confederate General [[Kleeve]], to Grievous|}} The '''Battle of Haruun Kal''' was a battle that took place on the [[planet]] [[Haruun Kal]] in [[19 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. [[Jedi General]] [[Depa Billaba]] led her [[Depa Billaba's battalion|battalion]] of [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] [[clone trooper]]s against enemy forces from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Separatist [[commander]], [[General]] [[Grievous]], engineered an onslaught that [[Death|claimed the lives]] of ninety percent of Billaba's [[troop]]s, resulting in a Confederate victory. Grievous personally bested Billaba in single [[Lightsaber combat|combat]], and she remained in a coma for the next six [[Standard month|months]] as she healed from her extensive injuries. Eventually, she recovered and received command of a [[Depa Billaba's second battalion|new battalion]] of [[soldier]]s, though her failure at Haruun Kal haunted her for some [[time]]. ==The battle== {{Quote|Her last mission? Her battalion suffered ''ninety percent'' casualties. ''Ninety!"
"''Who was she up against?''"
"''Way I hear it, ''General Grievous''.''"
"''Whoa…''"
"''Best case, he out-generaled her. Worst case, she's ''bad luck''. ''Cursed''.|[[Jedi Initiate|Jedi initiates]] [[Sammo Quid]] and [[Tai Uzuma]]|}} In [[19 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars]], the [[planet]]{{EncyclopediaCite|Mace Windu and Other Users of the Force}} [[Haruun Kal]] in the [[Mid Rim Territories]][[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] became a [[Ground warfare|battlefield]] when detachments from the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] and the [[Confederacy military|military]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] clashed there. Overseeing the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] [[infantry]] was [[Jedi General]] [[Depa Billaba]], a member of the [[Jedi High Council]]. Her [[Depa Billaba's battalion|battalion]] of [[clone trooper]]s encountered resistance in the form of the Confederate [[General]] [[Grievous]]. Grievous's forces decimated Billaba's [[troop]]s, causing her [[Battalion|unit]] to suffer ninety percent [[Death|casualties]]. Only four [[soldier]]s survived the carnage: [[Clone Commander|Commander]] [[Grey (clone trooper)|Grey]]; [[Clone Captain|Captain]] [[Styles]]; [[Sergeant]] [[Soot]]; and [[Corporal]] [[Big-Mouth]]. Grievous, meanwhile, [[Lightsaber duel|engaged]] Billaba in single [[Lightsaber combat|combat]] and defeated her,[[Kanan 11|''Kanan'' 11]] severely injuring her and rendering her comatose. Though Grievous failed to confirm her death, the Confederacy eventually learned of her survival and included it in its intelligence files. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|Am I…'damaged goods'? I imagine the answer is yes.''"
"''But you seem fully recovered.''"
"''From physical injury, yes. Nevertheless, the inescapable truth is…many good men ''died'' under ''my command''. Those deaths are ''my'' responsibility. And I ''fear'' causing more…which makes my ''usefulness'' as a commander in the field…''suspect''.|Depa Billaba and Caleb Dume|}} [[File:DepaBillabaBactaTank-Kanan7.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Billaba remained comatose for six months after her defeat on Haruun Kal.]] On account of the Republic's catastrophic losses, the Confederate forces claimed victory on Haruun Kal. Billaba was brought back to the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the Republic [[capital]] of [[Coruscant]], where she entered medical treatment. Some of her surviving men, including Styles and Grey, believed that they had failed her at Haruun Kal and swore to never do so again. Other troopers, however, came to regard her as "damaged goods" for her failure at Haruun Kal and the losses her command sustained. Billaba did not emerge from her coma until six [[Standard month|months]] later, at which point her fellow [[Jedi Master]]s evaluated her and allowed her to return to her seat on the [[Jedi]] High Council. Her defeat at Haruun Kal not only tarnished her reputation as a military [[commander]], but it also hindered her confidence as a general and forced her to live with the guilt of losing so many men. Nevertheless, she helped to thwart a [[Bombing at the Jedi Temple|Separatist attack]] on the Jedi Temple and resumed her military service with a new [[Padawan]], [[Kanan Jarrus|Caleb Dume]]. Grey, Styles, and the other survivors of Billaba's previous unit became the [[commanding officer]]s of her [[Depa Billaba's second battalion|new battalion]] within the Grand [[Army]]. Despite the fear that had entered many troopers' hearts after Haruun Kal that she was "damaged goods," Billaba's command, by the time of the [[Battle of Kaller]] at the war's end, included many soldiers who had served with her for years.{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}} Conflict leftover from the Clone Wars on Haruun Kal would culminate in the [[bombardment of Haruun Kal]] during the [[Imperial Era]].{{StoryCite|story=The Final Order|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}} ==Behind the scenes== The Battle of Haruun Kal was created as part of the backstory for ''[[Star Wars: Kanan]]'', a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series published by [[Marvel Comics]]. Writer [[Greg Weisman]] developed the details of the battle for the series' second story arc, [[Star Wars: Kanan Book II: First Blood|''First Blood'']]. The battle was initially alluded to in the story arc's [[Kanan 7|first issue]]. The plot point of Depa Billaba entering a coma after a [[Battle of Haruun Kal/Legends|battle on Haruun Kal]] originated in [[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']], a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel that was written by author [[Matthew Stover]] and published in [[June]] [[2003]].[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']] ==Appearances== *[[Kanan 7|''Kanan'' 7]] {{Imo}} *[[Kanan 9|''Kanan'' 9]] {{Mo}} *[[Kanan 11|''Kanan'' 11]] {{Imo}} *[[Kanan 1|''Kanan'' 1]] {{1stm}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'' *''[[Knights of Fate]]'' {{1stID|Battle of Haruun Kal}} *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{CanonCloneWarsNav}} {{Interlang |es=Batalla de Haruun Kal |fr=Bataille d'Haruun Kal |ja=ハルウン・コルの戦い |pt=Batalha de Haruun Kal }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Haruun Kal, Battle of}} [[Category:Battles of Haruun Kal]] [[Category:Battles of the Clone Wars]] [[Category:Lightsaber duels]]
